metadata.description: Deploy websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent — static hosting with every site at its own address (<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app), a per-site backend (KV, SQLite and file resources, each with its own read/write policy; visitor sign-in on the site's own address, separate from the owner's account sign-in; agents write with an API key), connect your own domain (subdomain or apex), and built-in visitor analytics. Legacy shared state and collections remain for existing sites only. Personal home choice, live showcase feed, bio, pins and order.

plugins.name: simple-host
plugins.description: Describe a website and it goes online at its own address. Claude builds the site and publishes it to simple-host.app through the Simple Host connector: pages, a small per-site backend (KV, SQLite and files) with visitor sign-in for saves and sign-ups, visitor analytics, and your own domain when you want one. Choose a personal home and curate the showcase with bio, pins and order.

plugins.name: website-deploy
plugins.description: Superseded by the simple-host plugin (Simple Host) — install that one instead; it bundles these same skills plus the Simple Host connector. Kept so existing installs keep updating. Deploy static websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent (inline JSON or tar.gz/zip). Every site lives at its own address, https://<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app/, and gets a per-site backend (KV, SQLite and file resources with visitor sign-in — separate from the owner's account sign-in, which a page never uses) and built-in server-side visitor analytics, and can be connected to your own custom domain — subdomain via CNAME or apex via A record. Legacy shared state, lists and declared kinds remain for existing sites only. Pages are readable by anyone; agents write with an API key anywhere. Bundles a builder skill (plan what to build) and a connect-domain skill.
